narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On September 17, 2024, at approximately 1500 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at an apartment complex in Grand Rapids, Michigan. The subject stated that he is a citizen of Mexico without documents.
ENTRY:
Asked whether he had come in through Nogales, the subject said no, he has never crossed at Nogales. He stated that he crossed through the desert near Sasabe, Arizona, in May 2019.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Notice to Appear.
